basis: Intestinal hypoperistalsis and microcolon with megacystis define disease; hydroureter and hydronephrosis support urinary involvement. Sepsis is a complication.
Carcinoma originates in and remains confined to the tracheal epithelium.
Mitochondrial ATP synthesis disorder; developmental delay, refractory seizures and brain atrophy occurred in the reported patient (1/1).
Congenital capillary malformations predominantly affect cutaneous vessels; visceral manifestations of particular subtypes do not apply across the umbrella.
Inherited developmental lens cataract.
Ependymal tumour arising in the central nervous system.
Frontonasal skeletal/nasal malformation; ocular defects and CNS malformations each 30-79% in HPO. Oral defects and hearing loss omitted by cap; endocrine findings 5-29%.
Cor pulmonale associated with chronic restrictive respiratory dysfunction from kyphoscoliosis; the underlying skeletal disorder is separately diagnosed.
Congenital reduction of digits on all four limbs, with additional hand and foot skeletal hypoplasia.
Mitochondrial metabolic defect; encephalopathy and cardiomyopathy occur in 30-79% or more. Respiratory failure does not establish intrinsic lung injury; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.
Chronic lymphatic obstruction produces lower-limb cutaneous and subcutaneous oedema, fibrosis and elephantiasis; lymphatic vessels have no explicit axis.
Sideroblastic anaemia is a disorder of erythropoiesis; clinically damaging iron overload is not established as common for this concept.
Hypophosphatemia, renal phosphate wasting and rickets/osteomalacia define disease. Dental abscesses are separate infections; iron deficiency is a modifier.
Bilateral renal agenesis, pulmonary hypoplasia and characteristic limb deformities define the oligohydramnios sequence.
Hypertension-associated renal vascular and parenchymal injury defines hypertensive nephropathy.
Urethral syndrome is a lower urinary tract disorder; infection is not intrinsic to the diagnosis.
SHH-related forebrain malformation; oral, ocular and pituitary abnormalities vary substantially, with no supplied frequency establishing 30% across this subtype.
Malignant tumour originates in the CNS; skeletal muscle differentiation does not establish skeletal muscle involvement.
Skin/eye UV injury defines XP. Supplied HPO reports neurodegeneration and hypogonadism at 80-99%; hearing loss at 30-79% omitted by cap. Frequencies are atypical for the umbrella.
Ischaemic necrosis and structural collapse affect bone; interrupted perfusion alone does not establish a separate vascular disorder.
Nonsyndromic inherited hearing loss, documented in 3/3 patients; other PNPT1-associated syndromes do not apply.
Hexosaminidase A deficiency causes GM2 storage with adult-onset motor neuron and cerebellar degeneration; weakness does not establish primary muscle disease.
Noncirrhotic portal vascular disease defines the condition; congestive hypersplenism with cytopenias is common (>30%). Cirrhosis is not required.
Isolated sperm flagellar dysfunction and male infertility; reproductive function has no axis, and endocrine gonadal dysfunction is not established.
Primary neurological headache disorder; no additional organ damage is established.
